patients.label: 49-year-old woman with cardiogenic shock after myocardial infarction and papillary muscle rupture
attribution_limitations: The myocardial infarction is described as silent and only "possibly" within the previous 7 days; the date of onset is not established. No inference beyond the hedged wording.

Surgical treatment is placed on ICU day 5 in one paragraph, and the CABG with mitral valve replacement is described in the next paragraph without a time and without a back-reference. The source does not identify them as the same operation, so they are separate events (p1-e19 timed, p1-e08 untimed) and their mutual order is left open. Do not infer that the CABG/MVR took place on ICU day 5.

Cardiac output is printed with an indexed unit (l/min/m^(2)) in the optimization paragraph, whereas the postoperative value is called cardiac index. The 2.1 and 2.4 values are kept as printed but review_only because the measured quantity is unresolved; no conversion or merging.

Postoperative days and "ICU day 5" are counted from unstated anchors (day of surgery and ICU admission are not given); times are kept literal without calendar values. The ECMO duration of 9 days and "postoperative day 10" weaning are not reconciled with each other.
Discussion sentences on levosimendan with CRRT, IABP indications and ECMO advantages are general statements citing literature, not patient facts, and are not recorded.

The indication for veno-arterial ECMO is not stated in the ECMO sentences themselves; the abstract and discussion call ECMO a rescue therapy/support after postoperative refractory cardiogenic shock. No indication attribute is recorded on the ECMO item; the order shock -> ECMO is kept as a timeline relation.
